config.conditions: Same pinned Remix, shipped and audit-start main snapshots. Fixed source 07ccd2ca8. Five rotating browser rounds, immutable cache headers, fresh contexts. Builds and this audit's tests run separately.

caveats: Optimized local builds. Warm Worker processes, fresh browser contexts per round.
Click time starts in the browser click handler and ends at the first animation frame with the destination marker visible. This is DOM/style readiness, not physical paint.
CDP latency is a minimum request latency, not a complete mobile network model.
No cookies, headers, query strings or response bodies are retained.
note: Identical initial resource inventories are shared by SHA-256 key. Per-step cumulative ResourceTiming arrays are omitted. Full raw runs remain in the archive. All per-sample initial metrics and per-step requests are preserved.
